test_cases.title: Add the 26 SIM providers
test_cases.preconditions: make seed-demo (or an empty DB with an admin); signed in
test_cases.steps: Administration → Settings → SIM providers: add each provider of settings_sim_providers.csv with its e-mail and default plan; choose Telia LT as the default; Non-return Value 30.00 €. Or PUT settings_sim_providers.request.json to /api/v1/settings/sim-providers
test_cases.expected: Settings lists 26 providers in order, Telia LT chosen first, 30.00 €

test_cases.title: Provider e-mails go nowhere real
test_cases.steps: Open a provider's e-mail on Settings
test_cases.expected: Every address is …@example.com, so a test e-mail never reaches an operator

test_cases.title: Check the Lithuania SIM list without writing
test_cases.preconditions: SIM-001 done; make seed-demo (for the holders)
test_cases.steps: make import-sims FILE=docs/test-packs/sim-cards-baltics-poland/import/sim-import-lt.csv
test_cases.expected: Each card is listed with its status and holder; nothing is written; no problems

test_cases.title: Check the Latvia SIM list without writing
test_cases.preconditions: SIM-001 done; make seed-demo (for the holders)
test_cases.steps: make import-sims FILE=docs/test-packs/sim-cards-baltics-poland/import/sim-import-lv.csv
test_cases.expected: Each card is listed with its status and holder; nothing is written; no problems

test_cases.title: Check the Estonia SIM list without writing
test_cases.preconditions: SIM-001 done; make seed-demo (for the holders)
test_cases.steps: make import-sims FILE=docs/test-packs/sim-cards-baltics-poland/import/sim-import-ee.csv
test_cases.expected: Each card is listed with its status and holder; nothing is written; no problems

test_cases.title: Check the Poland SIM list without writing
test_cases.preconditions: SIM-001 done; make seed-demo (for the holders)
test_cases.steps: make import-sims FILE=docs/test-packs/sim-cards-baltics-poland/import/sim-import-pl.csv
test_cases.expected: Each card is listed with its status and holder; nothing is written; no problems

test_cases.title: Import all four countries
test_cases.steps: make import-sims FILE=…/import/sim-import-all.csv COMMIT=yes
test_cases.expected: 91 SIM cards added in one go; held ones given to their employee with no form; Available and Not Activated in the Office

test_cases.title: Semicolons, a byte order mark and columns in another order
test_cases.steps: make import-sims FILE=…/import/sim-import-all-semicolon-bom.csv
test_cases.expected: Read the same as the comma file: same cards, no problems

test_cases.title: Running the import twice imports nothing
test_cases.steps: Run SIM-007's command again
test_cases.expected: Refused: every SIM No. is already registered; nothing written

test_cases.title: Every problem is listed, nothing written
test_cases.steps: make import-sims FILE=…/import/sim-import-errors.csv
test_cases.expected: Nothing is written. First pass: lines 2-4 named (Available with a holder, unknown employee, unknown status). Delete them and run again: the unknown provider is only noted, line 6 refused (not a phone number), and after SIM-007 line 5 (SIM No. already registered)

test_cases.title: Tabs count and filter by status
test_cases.steps: Company Assets → SIM Cards; open each tab
test_cases.expected: Counts match sim_cards.csv's statuses (Available counts as Active)

test_cases.title: Phone numbers of four countries
test_cases.steps: Open an LV, an EE and a PL card
test_cases.expected: Phone No. shown as written (+371 …, +372 …, +48 …)

test_cases.title: Find a card by number in ⌘K
test_cases.steps: ⌘K, type the last 6 digits of a SIM No.
test_cases.expected: The card is found and opens beside the register

test_cases.title: Add SIM by hand for each country
test_cases.steps: Add SIM with a SIM No. of block 3 (any provider) from add_sim_manual.csv
test_cases.expected: Added Not Activated in the Office, provider's default plan and the 30.00 € value filled in

test_cases.title: A prepaid card
test_cases.steps: Add SIM, provider Labas (or any prepaid brand)
test_cases.expected: The plan is the brand's prepaid plan from Settings

test_cases.title: Give SIM against a printed form
test_cases.preconditions: an Active card in the Office
test_cases.steps: Give SIM to Ona Kazlauskienė; print the form; Upload Signed Form (any PDF)
test_cases.expected: Given; form printed with provider, plan, phone and value; signed copy listed

test_cases.title: Print Form for an imported held card
test_cases.preconditions: SIM-007 done; Edit the card's Non-return Value first
test_cases.steps: Open a held card from the import → ⋯ → Print Form
test_cases.expected: Without a value it says so; with one it prints, dated 2026-08-03; asset.form_printed recorded

test_cases.title: Return and Mark as Not Returned
test_cases.steps: Return one; Mark the other as Not Returned with a reason
test_cases.expected: The first is back in the Office; the second shows Not Returned; neither status changed

test_cases.title: Change Status never moves the card
test_cases.steps: Change Status → Blocked
test_cases.expected: Blocked, still with its holder

test_cases.title: Prepare Activation Email
test_cases.preconditions: a Not Activated card; Mail Templates set
test_cases.steps: Open the card → Prepare Activation Email
test_cases.expected: To is the provider's example.com address, the card's numbers filled in; Send Email only opens your mail app

test_cases.title: Prepare Blocking Email
test_cases.steps: Prepare Blocking Email
test_cases.expected: As above, the blocking template

test_cases.title: Scan the valid printed cards
test_cases.preconditions: SIM-001 done; scan_cards.html printed or on a second screen
test_cases.steps: Open /apps/sim-scan/; For every SIM: provider; photograph front and back of SC-001…SC-052 (by provider)
test_cases.expected: Each SIM No. read from the Code 128 barcode, never the EAN-13; PIN and PUK read; Add adds them all

test_cases.title: The review list marks every problem
test_cases.steps: Scan SC-053…SC-060
test_cases.expected: Check digit, duplicate, …5F, PIN, PUK and registered cards are marked; Add refuses until fixed

test_cases.title: Show PIN and PUK
test_cases.preconditions: cards added by SIM-022; a recent sign-in
test_cases.steps: Show PIN and PUK; find a card by number
test_cases.expected: Asks for your password if the sign-in is not recent; shows the codes from scan_cards.csv; recorded as asset.sim_codes_shown

test_cases.title: An employee sees no SIM cards
test_cases.steps: Sign in as the employee; open /assets/sim-cards
test_cases.expected: Company Assets is not offered; the API answers 403

test_cases.title: Every change is in the Changes
test_cases.steps: Open a card → Changes; Administration → Audit log, filter asset.*
test_cases.expected: asset.registered, asset.given, asset.returned, asset.status_changed … with who and when
